messages:
Jamal: Quick check-in — day 3 for me.
- Done: cloned monorepo, got local env + venv, ran unit tests (most pass, 2 failing flaky tests).
- Blockers: 1) pushing to repo returns 403 (no write access), 2) KMS key not available so e2e blocked, 3) docker build failing intermittently (see logs).
- Today: trying to reproduce and fix the two failing tests; will open access request for repo. cc @Sophia @Nina

Sophia: Thanks Jamal — good summary. Can you paste the exact 403 output and the failing test names so I can ping infra?

Jamal: Sure — error when pushing:```error: failed to push some refs to 'git@github.com:redwood/redwood.git'
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/redwood.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403```
Failing tests output:```FAILED tests/test_cache.py::test_cache_eviction - AssertionError: expected 3 got 2
FAILED tests/test_timezones.py::test_utc_conversion - AssertionError: timezone mismatch```

Nina: Hey Jamal — saw the docker issue yesterday. Try `export DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1` then `bazel clean --expunge` before the build. Also infra often needs you added to the "redwood-dev" GitHub team for push rights — I'll ping them.

devex-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: "Repo access" marked BLOCKED. If you'd like, open an access request at https://onboard.redwood/requests and include your GitHub handle.

Sophia: Infra answered my thread: they require an access-requests PR with your GH handle + manager approval. @Jamal can you open that PR? I can shepherd once it's up.

Jamal: Done — created PR here: https://github.com/redwood-infra/access-requests/pull/42 added my handle (jamal-dev). Also started a branch `jamal/test-fix-1` to address the timezone flaky test — initial repro looks like test depends on local TZ.

Nina: Nice. To speed up iteration, run `pytest -k test_cache_eviction -q` to only run the flaky cache test. For the timezone test, consider using freezegun or setting TZ in the test environment.

Jamal: Good tip — running targeted test now. One more ask: KMS access is blocking local e2e runs. If infra can't grant access quickly, can we request a temp dev key or a mocked KMS endpoint?

Sophia: I'll ask security + infra for a temp dev key for onboarding (short TTL). Meanwhile focus on unit fixes.

Jamal: Update 30m later: targeted pytest shows timezone test fails consistently; switching to freezegun in the test, will open PR after CI passes. Docker build fixed by toggling BUILDKIT and clearing cache as Nina suggested. Thanks! :thumbsup:
